Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions?
We have answers.

If you have any other questions, feel free to contact our support team anytime.

What is an SMM panel?

An SMM panel is a platform that offers social media marketing services such as followers, likes, and views for various platforms.

How do I sign up and log in?

You can sign up by clicking the "Sign Up" button and filling out the registration form. To log in, simply enter your username and password on the login page.

Do you have a reseller program?

Yes, we offer a reseller program so you can provide services to your own clients. Contact us for more details.

How can I reach your support team?

You can reach our support team 24/7 via our ticket system or the contact channels on our website.

Support available for order issues?

Yes, our dedicated technical support team is available to help you with any issues you may encounter. Just open a support ticket.

Can I start my own SMM panel?

Yes, we offer special discounts for resellers who want to start their own SMM panel. Please contact us for more information on our reseller program.

What payment methods do you accept?

You can pay securely via credit card, bank transfer, and various online payment systems like PayPal and cryptocurrencies.

Can you clarify your refund and cancellation policies?

We offer refunds for any remaining balance in your account. For specific order cancellations and refunds, please contact our support team to review your case.

How long does it take to complete orders?

Order completion time depends on the service type and demand, but usually starts within minutes of placing the order.

What happens if my order is not completed?

If an order cannot be completed, the amount for the undelivered portion will be automatically refunded to your panel balance.

Are your services safe to use?

Yes, all our services are completely safe for your accounts. We only use secure methods to deliver high-quality results.

Can I resell your services via API?

Absolutely! We provide a fully integrated API that allows you to easily resell our services on your own platform.

Child Panel Rules

  • Child panels are intended for resale purposes only. You are responsible for managing and supporting your own clientele.
  • Any form of fraudulent activity, spam, or abuse conducted through the child panel will result in immediate suspension and potential termination of your account.

  • We reserve the right to update the terms of service, features, and pricing for child panels with prior notice.

How to Connect Your Domain

To connect your domain, you need to change its nameservers at your domain registrar (the company you bought the domain from). Please update them to the following:
